test_title: PYST 1: SSC CGL Tier - II (English) (Held on: 8 Aug 2022)
subject: english
question: **Select the wrongly spelt word.**
solution:
The erroneous spelling is: **Plataue**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The correct spelling should be **'Plateau'.**
 
• **Plateau** means a usually extensive land area having a relatively level surface raised sharply above adjacent land on at least one side.
 
 
• **Example -** Continental
